brief:
Former Palestinian Authority minister Sufian Abu Zaida said he served as an intermediary between Israel and Hamas before October 7, 2023, according to Middle East Eye. Abu Zaida promised to reveal the message that Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar wanted Israel to receive through this channel.

The intermediary role and the content of any such communication have not yet been publicly disclosed.

title: Ex-Palestinian minister says he carried Sinwar message to Israel
